description: Road corridors is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Melbourne. This shapefile shows all of the public road and laneway segments within the City of Melbourne. This outlines the street name and the names of the between streets For further information on who is the responsible authority for the road can be found in the attached document. Coverage: City of Melbourne. The portal files it under the publisher City of Melbourne. Its tags are laneways, roads, safemobility, segments, street-names. It offers 7 resource(s) in CSV, DOCX, GEOJSON, JSON, KML. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
